answer: Deposits are visible in marble, and prism reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 144 aliases, and each one needs its own funded trellis account. A bond of 45% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. The per-identity price is 9 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
